fee_notes: Royalty is the greater of 6% of weekly Gross Sales or $400 per week (minimum $400/week = ~$1,733/month annualized, here converted to ~$1,600/month as 4-week proxy). Local Marketing is 2% of weekly Gross Sales (paid to franchisor for local spend). Advertising Fund is an additional 2% of weekly Gross Sales — combined marketing/ad fund total is 4% of Gross Sales. Tech/POS/computer maintenance is approximately $2,400–$7,500 per year paid to third parties (not a franchisor tech fee). Advisory Council fee amount TBD by Advisory Council. Transfer fee is 50% of then-current initial franchise fee per restaurant. Renewal fee is 10% of then-current initial franchise fee. Walmart sublessee rent: 2%–12% of gross revenues/month plus insurance fee $0–$300/month plus CAM fee $975–$2,000/month. Training fee currently $200/person/day (initial training free for up to 2 individuals). Return fee $50 per returned EFT. Interest on late fees: lesser of 18% per annum or maximum permitted by law.
